Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu ! i am a 21 year old girl and am studying.i go to college throug bus and i knew one of the conductors very well and i fell love with him.he is also a muslim but he is not educated as me. my parents want to marry me to educated person and also a rich one.i can't forget him'what should i do?did i obey my parents or continue with him? Answer ID: 10676 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 229/166=H/1429) You must obey your parents and stop speaking altogether with the conductor. It is deception from Satan and nafs ; they instigate you that you cannot forget him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
